# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime reliability and platform support**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves native reliability, rendering performance, and support across Apple, Android, Linux, and WebAssembly. It corrects native data handling and stream lifetime issues, reduces managed and HarfBuzz allocation overhead, and updates bundled platform components for current toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Native data creation handles C strings safely** — SKData creation now determines the native string length correctly and writes directly into the resulting data, avoiding reads beyond the source buffer. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Streams that use a front buffer no longer retain data after it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows the display refresh** — Texture rendering is synchronized with display refresh to provide smoother Android output. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Pixel and text shaping paths allocate less** — Managed image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string handling reduce temporary allocation work. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple platform minimums updated** — Apple native packages now target the current supported deployment baselines. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Linux and WebAssembly native assets updated** — Linux packages bind the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, while WebAssembly static libraries include the emdawnwebgpu implementation. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Windows native builds use current tooling** — Windows packages are built with Visual Studio 2026 and a refreshed ANGLE Chromium revision. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
